note: Both sets correctly capture the PVC material note and the 1/4 in/ft minimum waste-pipe slope with its 2009 IRC condition, and both bind the INT. STEP and FINISH FLOOR elevations to the GROUND PLANE datum. Set A additionally captures the CEILING FINISH elevation of 10'-0 1/2", an important datum fact on the page that Set B omits. Both sets state the PVC material fact twice (supply and waste), which is a mild duplication but not a misread.
remarks: The datum block (GROUND PLANE 0", FINISH FLOOR, CEILING FINISH, INT. STEP) appears twice in the text layer; both sets treat it consistently. Splitting the single 'ALL SUPPLY AND WASTE PIPE TO BE PVC PIPING' note into two claims is defensible but reads as duplication.
